card.name: Citation and author-name details in science text
card.fires_on: Small pieces inside reference lists and researcher names in science writing, such as years, volume and page numbers, "et al.,", and partway through surnames. Often found where lab or research work is being described.

modes.label: Citation numbers
modes.description: Digits, spaces or commas inside journal references, such as volume, year and page numbers.

modes.label: Researcher names
modes.description: Partway through a scientist's surname or first name in a news-style science story.
modes.example: In some respects, Raymond-<<Wh>>ish and Curie are not dissimilar

modes.label: In-text author citations
modes.description: The comma or period after "et al" in a parenthetical citation.

card.writes: It pushes the word patients and its variants and pushes down mouse, rat and rodent words, nudging the output toward human rather than animal subjects.
card.plain: It lights up on bits of citations and researcher names in research writing, and leans the model toward saying patients rather than mice.
